colors.label: HealthTech Teal
colors.description: Core brand teal. Use for light-theme links and buttons with MedTech OffWhite text.

colors.label: MedTech OffWhite
colors.description: Inspired by the off-white finish of MRI machines. Use for light backgrounds and text on dark surfaces.

colors.label: BioTech Gold
colors.description: Represents the monetary potential of biotechnology. Use for accents on dark surfaces; use Gold Ink for text on light surfaces.

colors.label: LifeTech Deep Ink
colors.description: Primary text on light backgrounds, dark-theme canvas, and text on light teal or gold buttons.

colors.label: Deep Teal Surface
colors.description: Dark-theme panels and navigation; pair with MedTech OffWhite, Light Teal, or BioTech Gold.

colors.label: Light Teal
colors.description: Accessible links, focus indicators, and primary buttons on dark surfaces. Pair filled buttons with Deep Ink text.

colors.label: Teal Mist
colors.description: Light-theme secondary surfaces and selected rows. Pair with Deep Ink or HealthTech Teal text.

colors.label: Muted Ink
colors.description: Secondary text on white, MedTech OffWhite, and Teal Mist; retains normal-text contrast.

colors.label: Muted Light
colors.description: Secondary text on Deep Ink and Deep Teal Surface; retains normal-text contrast.

colors.label: Gold Ink
colors.description: Accessible gold-family text on white, MedTech OffWhite, and Teal Mist. Original BioTech Gold remains the core accent.

colors.label: Control Teal
colors.description: Input boundaries and essential control indicators on light surfaces; use Light Teal for dark-theme focus.

colors.label: Clinical White
colors.description: Raised light-theme surfaces; use Deep Ink, Muted Ink, HealthTech Teal, or Gold Ink for text.

colors.label: Research Violet
colors.description: Readable research-category text on light surfaces.

colors.label: Research Violet Light
colors.description: Research-category text and indicators on dark surfaces.

colors.label: Care Coral
colors.description: Readable care-category text on light surfaces.

colors.label: Care Coral Light
colors.description: Care-category text and indicators on dark surfaces.

colors.label: Community Green
colors.description: Readable community-category text on light surfaces.

colors.label: Community Green Light
colors.description: Community-category text and indicators on dark surfaces.
